en: a person who has very strong, unreasonable beliefs or opinions about race, religion or politics and who will not listen to or accept the opinions of anyone who disagrees
ex: a religious/racial bigot
宗教／种族的偏执者

en: showing strong, unreasonable beliefs or opinions and refusing to change them
ex: a bigoted man
偏执的人

en: the state of feeling, or the act of expressing, strong, unreasonable beliefs or opinions
ex: When religious people show bigotry and intolerance, they are in fact betraying the religion they uphold.
当信教的人表现出偏执和不宽容时，他们实际上是背叛了自己坚持的宗教。
